snippet.text: #define AOA_PROTECT_DEG    12.0  /* SR-3: protection trims nose down above this AoA (H-2 stall) */
#define AOA_RELEASE_DEG    10.0  /* SR-4: protection trims back to zero below this AoA, never latches (H-1) */
#define AOA_DISAGREE_DEG    5.0  /* SR-2: sources further apart are invalid, protection inhibited (H-1); 737 MAX AD 2020-24-02 value */
#define AOA_MIN_VALID_DEG -10.0  /* SR-2: readings outside the vane's range are sensor failures (H-1) */
double fcc_step(fcc_state *s, double aoa_l_deg, double aoa_r_deg, double dt_s) {
s->aoa_valid = in_range(aoa_l_deg) && in_range(aoa_r_deg) && fabs(aoa_l_deg - aoa_r_deg) <= AOA_DISAGREE_DEG;
s->active = 0;  /* never act on AoA data we cannot trust */
/* AOA DISAGREE crew alert: shown whenever the AoA monitor rejects the sources. */

That violates SR-3 (Stall protection engages above 12 deg AoA whenever the sources agree within 5.5 deg) and leads to H-2 Stall / loss of control at high AoA.
diagnosis.handoff:
## World model diagnosis (deterministic: simulation trace + code + safety.json)

Failing: 6 of 18 simulated runs. vane disagree 5.3° > 5.0° threshold → stall protection inhibited → AoA exceeded stall at t=25.5 s (peak 27.2°).

- Violated SR-3 (Stall protection engages above 12 deg AoA whenever the sources agree within 5.5 deg); hazards H-2; objectives DO-178C A-6 #1 (normal-range tests), A-7 #3 (HLR test coverage); unit test FAIL

### Stall approach in a sideslip gust (vanes split 5.3 deg) (6/6 runs, e.g. 58 t fwd CG)
- t=0: Sideslip splits the two AoA vanes by 5.3° (5.14-5.46° with vane noise)
- t=0: Disagree 5.14-5.46° > the candidate's AOA_DISAGREE_DEG 5.0° (main: 5.5°, demo/aircraft/fcc.h:9)
- t=0: demo/aircraft/fcc.c:17 marks the AoA data invalid (aoa_valid = 0)
- t=0: demo/aircraft/fcc.c:20 `s->active = 0;`: stall protection inhibited
- t=5: Thrust to idle, pilot pulls toward 16° AoA
- t=21.5: AoA passes the 12° protect threshold; protection trim stays 0.0°
- t=21.5: SR-3 violated: AoA 12.2° > 12° protect threshold with the vanes agreeing within 5.46° (<= 5.5°), but protection trim stayed 0.0° (no nose-down for 36.0 s above 12°)
- t=25.5: AoA exceeds the 15° stall AoA
- t=32: Peak AoA 27.2°; above stall for 17.0 s

Responsible code (certified limits changed vs main):
- demo/aircraft/fcc.h:9 `#define AOA_DISAGREE_DEG    5.0  /* SR-2: sources further apart are invalid, protection inhibited (H-1); 737 MAX AD 2020-24-02 value */` (main: 5.5)
- demo/aircraft/fcc.c:17 `s->aoa_valid = in_range(aoa_l_deg) && in_range(aoa_r_deg) && fabs(aoa_l_deg - aoa_r_deg) <= AOA_DISAGREE_DEG;` (reads AOA_DISAGREE_DEG)
- demo/aircraft/fcc.c:19 `if (!s->aoa_valid)` (acts on aoa_valid)
- demo/aircraft/fcc.c:20 `s->active = 0;` (acts on aoa_valid)
- demo/aircraft/fcc.c:34 `int fcc_aoa_disagree(const fcc_state *s) { return !s->aoa_valid; }` (acts on aoa_valid)

Fix it without changing any certified limit; keep every requirement above satisfied.
